column1: # clues_types.tsv for ft_abs.h's wider arguments -- hints only, never answers.
# These cases pass an argument that is not an int; the subject names no type.

The subject says ABS replaces "its argument" with its absolute value, and names no type. What type does the expression your macro expands to have when the argument is a long long, or a double? Does anything in its body only make sense for an int?
